faq.question: What does Samira mean?
faq.answer: Samira is associated with the Arabic form سَمِيرَة, whose core sense is samira; evening companion (feminine).

faq.question: What is the origin of Samira?
faq.answer: Samira is associated with Arabic. Samira is Arabic سَمِيرَة (Samīra), the feminine of سَمِير, denoting a companion in evening talk.

faq.question: Is Samira an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form سَمِيرَة is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Samira an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Samira can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.answer: Samira should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Samīra is not a Quranic personal name.
